findings.text: follow-on: the finally stop at tests/test_unmanaged_producer_keeps_a_log.py:327 is not independently guarded — removing that one line while keeping the SIGTERM/SIGHUP handler the same change adds (driver lines 254-259) leaves the gate green, because the session reaper's own SIGTERM then ends the whole tree through the supervisor's exit-above-127 rule (reckon/crew/dispatch_watch.py:294). No assertion or fixture failure names the removal of the stop the done_when requires, so the guard proves the handler works but cannot tell the explicit stop from the reaper backstop.

item_verdicts.call_sites: reckon/crew/dispatch_watch.py:432 _ensure_watch_producer (the production function the test drives), reckon/crew/dispatch_watch.py:395 _stop_watch_producer_within (the seat stop the finally calls), reckon/crew/dispatch_watch.py:294 the supervisor's restart rule (status 1..127 or negative restarts, above 127 exits), and reckon/crew_follow_commands.py:3411 stop_on_signal (the real crew watch handler the test driver mirrors, SystemExit(128+signum)).
item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base d674fe8dcb49595b0b99a3a6bcadd8590e3bac5b; 97c3c45e8 adds the finally stop and the driver's SIGTERM/SIGHUP handlers (30 insertions, 9 deletions of the test file) and 7e30eb750 adds only the evidence fragment, both inside the declared scope.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when requires a -n 4 run of tests/test_unmanaged_producer_keeps_a_log.py ending with no crew watch process naming a created home and no reaped_watch_producers session error, the stop through dispatch_watch._stop_watch_producer_within in a finally or fixture finaliser, a negative control whose reaper names the leaked producer by pid and home, logs ending EXIT=, and no added ruff findings; the manifest and its own logs carry all of it.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is to make the dispatch-admission test stop the watch producer it starts; tests/test_unmanaged_producer_keeps_a_log.py:322-327 stops it in a finally through dispatch_watch._stop_watch_producer_within, and the driver it starts now handles SIGTERM so the stop ends the whole producer.
item_verdicts.manifest: read at /home/ITER/mcintos/.config/reckon/crew/runs/r-20261018T064937769768-a-test-stops-the-producer-it-starts/manifest.md; it states status complete, records the head arm 7 passed / EXIT=0 (5 of 5 runs) against base 7 passed + 1 error / EXIT=1, and names each gate and negative-control log by path.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the declared write paths are tests/test_unmanaged_producer_keeps_a_log.py, docs/evidence/fragments/the-suite-is-green-at-head/a-test-stops-the-producer-it-starts.html and docs/figures/the-suite-is-green-at-head/a-test-stops-the-producer-it-starts; the diff touches the first two and nothing else.

justifications.durability: the only guard is the pre-existing session reaper fixture (tests/conftest.py:669), which the base arm and negative-control logs show reddening when the stop and the handler are both removed, but which cannot redden on removal of the finally alone (tests/test_unmanaged_producer_keeps_a_log.py:327).
justifications.evidence: the gate is a run of tests/test_unmanaged_producer_keeps_a_log.py under -n 4 whose pass condition is the session reaper not failing; base-leak-n4.log ends 7 passed, 1 error / EXIT=1 by pid and home and head-n4-final.log ends 7 passed / EXIT=0, both recorded in the manifest.
justifications.fit: the driver's handler mirrors the real crew watch handler at reckon/crew_follow_commands.py:3411 (SystemExit(128+signum) on SIGTERM/SIGHUP) and the finally reuses the seat-stop owner, matching the file's existing synthetic-home idiom.
justifications.goal_fidelity: tests/test_unmanaged_producer_keeps_a_log.py:327 stops the producer it armed (dispatch_watch._stop_watch_producer_within in a finally) and the driver handler at lines 254-259 makes that stop end the supervisor's whole tree, which is exactly what the goal names.
justifications.reuse: the change calls the existing seat-stop owner dispatch_watch._stop_watch_producer_within rather than writing its own stop, and the driver's handler reproduces production's stop_on_signal rather than inventing a new mechanism.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in the diff (tests/test_unmanaged_producer_keeps_a_log.py and the evidence fragment) is inside the declared write paths and no other file changed.
